name: Ogi-Ohashi
tagline: Otemachi in 29 minutes and Tokyo in 31 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥60,000 to ¥70,000.
summary: The station is in Adachi City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 41 minutes to Shinjuku, 47 minutes to Shibuya and 45 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥60,000 to ¥70,000. The station stands 2.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 0.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.3 m to 2.1 m, a difference of 0.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 9 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 5 to 10 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: ライフ 扇大橋駅前店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 米倉脊椎・関節病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京女子医科大学附属足立医療センター, about 20 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Nippori-Toneri Liner.
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Nippori-Toneri Liner. It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: One room ¥60,000 to ¥70,000, 1K ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1LDK ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 2LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥60,000 to ¥70,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Ogi-Ohashi.

neighbours.lead: Adachi-Odai is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Ogi-Ohashi is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Ogi-Ohashi.

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
尾久橋通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively many of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Nippori-Toneri Liner serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
